beta.9 connects seven newly collected complete public web editions (650 photos), selects 323 larger unchanged files across four works, resolves duplicate catalogue IDs to acquired works, and directs Teddy Bear v04 to all 97 photos. Highest resolution remains unverified regardless of pixel dimensions.

beta.10 ranks verified actual resolution first and verified absence of a gallery-site watermark at equal dimensions second. Unknown is never claimed clean. Preserve source bytes and reject smaller clean replacements and AI replacements of non-AI editions. New ArtGravia 663 public AI-enhanced web edition has all 32 photos (64 distinct files in two editions); 32 larger 1368px files selected. No publisher-original claim. Open-photo overlay is more transparent.

beta.10 further selects 253 larger unchanged web files: Heart Steal 78/78 at 1920px, CREAM 100/228 at 2048px and RAMEN 75/125 at 1920px. Album cards are half their previous height at equal width, with top-left publisher and dim photo count, top-right AI/web/original verification badge. Detail photo grid dimensions are unchanged.

beta.10 also removes the user-confirmed wrong-model sexiest18 (18 images) from the public gallery and collection targets, blocks its source and hashes from reimport, and puts search behind a small translucent corner button with history-aware popup.

beta.11 uses hash-bound local facial region metadata to select and frame album covers without changing any photo pixels or in-album image order. Cover titles omit publisher branding, use translucent small text, and preserve full original titles for search/accessibility. New acquisitions for beta.11 are not claimed until actual files are verified.

beta.11 also reuses two existing verified public reference files in their full Yui Vol.3 106-photo edition: photo50 2400x1600 and photo81 2048x1366 replace 1368x912 files after whole-frame comparison. No newly acquired files or publisher-master claim; all input copies remain.

beta.12 archives 402 new photograph files plus 80 separate non-photographic inputs from explicit creator posts and Korean/Japanese/Chinese public publishers, events, photographers, editorial and board pages. These are SHA-256 file counts, not unique poses or complete new photobooks. Register 401 image entries in five explicitly incomplete public collections; prefer four larger unchanged creator-source files over lower editorial variants and retain one equal-size duplicate privately. DJAWA provides 24 public sample photos of an advertised 190-photo edition, not the full book.

beta.13 adds publisher browsing with verified official-brand logo provenance, catalogued/viewable counts and native history through publisher/album/photo levels. Unconfirmed publishers and public editorial/event/SNS material stay separate. No new photographs are claimed by this UI change.

Replace 70 existing 1024x1535 files with 1201x1800 files; retain ten2699px and seventeen2303px files. The same larger Teddy71 file is reused in its existing editorial item. One alternate source file timed out twice and was recovered by its normal unmodified browser request. No new poses/full books or publisher master are claimed. Eight publisher brand assets include the MAXIM parent mark for BCUT and the SWEETBOX photographer profile image. Yo-U is a plainly labelled name fallback pending logo verification.

beta.14 replaces the four visible browse tabs with a single publisher/album toggle, sorts publishers and displayed album titles in Korean-locale ascending natural order, and hides global photo/all-catalogue navigation. Album photo order, image bytes and source choices remain unchanged. New acquisition counts will change only after verified individual files are obtained.

No image bytes, gallery photo data, source choices or navigation changes.

Existing photo choices and sequences remain unchanged; add one verified publisher logo and scoped source adapters. Primary private cloud remains unconnected.

Only list presentation changes: original image bytes, image choices, full viewer, in-album photo grid, publisher logos and photo order remain unchanged. beta.18 collects 683 unchanged individual input files and selects 427 newly verified larger same-frame files for six existing works: Thru Thru 117/117, Yui Vol.2 42/42, Wet 79/80, RAMEN 50/125, Kuro 35/58 and Yui Vol.3 104/106. Retain the already larger RAMEN 75, Kuro 23 and Vol.3 two files; Wet photo2 remains a full-frame match still to obtain. Two named model indexes and explicitly credited article bodies extend the free collector. No new complete books, publisher masters or personal-cloud verification are claimed; highest resolution remains under review.

beta.19 displays explicit image-load failure states in album cards, aligned photo grids and the viewer. The user reported HTTP 451 from cdn.jliji.com in Korea; a cross-origin image error cannot reveal its actual status and is not claimed to be 451. Do not automatically re-request a failed image from that reported origin when opening its viewer, and retain the original direct open link. No proxy, alternate origin, image replacement, new acquisition, legal-restriction bypass or restored-access claim. CI success outside the affected region does not verify Korean access.
beta.20 gallery: only physically stored SHA-256 files or authenticated owner-backed bytes count as gallery images. Source URLs are research records, not active photos.

beta.21: both galleries accept a SHA-256-verified user ZIP and persist JPEG bytes in per-device IndexedDB. Private Drive backup 218 images is packaged separately and is not falsely counted as online imported photos until the user imports the file on their device.
